theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_tg_tangent_gluing
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A B : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ B → B ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict A), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q) → ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U B : Set (Euclid P)) (S : ℕ → Set (Euclid P)) (Q : Euclid P → Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet B → B ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∀ j, MeasurableSet (S j)) → (∀ j, S j ⊆ B) → B ⊆ ⋃ j, S j → (∀ j, ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict (S j)), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n (S j) x (Q x)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict B), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x (Q x)
